# Problem 1:

```{python}
#|echo: false 
#|output: true
from contextlib import redirect_stdout, redirect_stderr
import io
import warnings
import logging
from lcapy import *

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
logging.getLogger('lcapy').setLevel(logging.ERROR)

with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()), redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
    Converter = Circuit(r"""
    #create voltage source
        V ._plus  0 {V_g  }; down, size=2
    #create inductor
        L L.1 L.2; right, l= L, size=1.5
    # create SW1
        SW1 ._COM ._NC ._NO spdt; invert, l={}
        A1 SW1._NC; l=1, anchor=south west
        A2 SW1._NO; l=2, anchor=north west
    #create SW2
        SW2 ._COM ._NO ._NC spdt; mirror, l={}
        A3 SW2._NC; l=1, anchor=north west
        A4 SW2._NO; l=2, anchor=south west
    #create RC
        C C.1 C.2; right, l= C
        R R.1 R.2; right, l= R, v={$+\quad V\quad -$}
        O _RC1 C.1; right, rotate=45, size=0.75, 
        O _RC1 R.1; right, rotate=-45, size=0.75
        W _RC1 C.1; steps=|-, free
        W _RC1 R.1; steps=|-, free
        ;;\draw (_RC1)node[circ];
        O C.2 _RC2; right, rotate=-45, size=0.75
        O R.2 _RC2; right, rotate=45, size=0.75
        W C.2 _RC2; steps=-|, free
        W R.2 _RC2; steps=-|, free
        ;;\draw (_RC2)node[circ];
    #create connections:
    # connect RC to switches
        W SW1._COM _RC1; right, size=0.1
        W _RC2 SW2._COM; right, size=0.1
    # connect voltage source to inductor
        W V._plus L.1; right, size=0
    # connect inductor L to switches
        W L.2 SW1._NC; down
        W L.2 SW2._NO; steps=-|, free
    # connect ground to switches
        O SW1._NO 0_0; down, size=1
        W SW1._NO 0_0; down
        ;;\draw (0_0)node[circ];
        W 0 0_0; right
        W 0_0 SW2._NC; steps=-|, free
        ; autoground=false, draw_nodes=connections, label_ids=false, label_nodes=alpha, european voltages""")
    Converter.draw()
```

* The inductor has ohmic resistance $R_L$.
* All the other losses are neglected.
* The switches operate in a complementary manner, such that:
    - The switches on mode $1$ in time interval $\left[0, DT_s\right]$.
    - The switches on mode $2$ in time interval $\left[D T_s, T_s\right]$.
